key_claims.claim: Pooled data allow quantification of net clinical benefit from thromboprophylaxis in pregnant patients with mild-risk thrombophilia including heterozygous Factor V Leiden, prothrombin gene variant, and Protein C/S deficiency
Universal dispensation of 162mg aspirin at a safety-net obstetric program was associated with reduced severe preeclampsia compared to risk-stratified approaches
Long COVID classification is associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes including preterm birth after propensity-score adjustment
In term-born children, fetal size at birth shows more persistent association with neurodevelopmental outcomes through adolescence than gestational age within the 37-41 week range
High versus low transvaginal cerclage placement shows no significant difference in pregnancy loss rates
